title: Guest Care Standard: Travel Issues During a Stay
content:
# Guest Care Standard — travel issues

**Scope.** This standard applies to a guest of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category who meets a serious problem at a stay. There are four travel-issue categories:

| Category | Meaning |
|---|---|
| No access | the guest cannot get in |
| Uninhabitable | the place is unsafe or unsanitary |
| Misrepresented | the place differs materially from the listing |
| Amenity missing | an essential amenity listed is missing |

The guest reports the problem as a travel-issue stay request.

## Clauses in force

1. **Cleaning fee.** The cleaning fee is refunded in full as well when the request's issue category is one of the policy's cleaning-fee categories (no access and uninhabitable) and the request was submitted on the check-in date.
2. **How refunds are posted.** Travel-issue refunds are posted with the travel-issue reason and the reference of the request. Nightly and cleaning components are funded by the host, and service fee and tax components are funded by the platform.
3. **Cap and policy.** Travel-issue refunds never count toward the guest service fee refund cap, and the cancellation policy of the stay does not limit them.

## Clauses no longer in force

Each of the following former clauses is no longer in force as worded; it has been superseded by the current basis:

- that a travel-issue refund is issued only when Roamhaven has approved the travel-issue request;
- that a travel issue is eligible only when the guest reported it no more than the policy's reporting window in elapsed hours after the guest discovered the issue, counted in elapsed clock time from the discovery time recorded on the request to its submission time;
- that the affected nights are the stay's nights dated on or after the date of submission and before the check-out date, and that the nightly refund is the category percentage for the request's issue category times one night's price times the affected nights;
- that the guest service fee and occupancy tax are refunded in the proportion that the refunded nightly and cleaning amounts bear to their full amounts.

## Cleaning-fee clause — cases (hypothetical requests)

| Category | Submitted | Cleaning fee refunded in full under clause 1 |
|---|---|---|
| No access | on the check-in date | yes |
| Uninhabitable | on the check-in date | yes |
| Uninhabitable | the day after the check-in date | no |
| Misrepresented | on the check-in date | no |

superseded_clauses: A travel-issue refund is issued only when Roamhaven has approved the travel-issue request.

A travel issue is eligible only when the guest reported it no more than travel_issue_report_hours elapsed hours after the guest discovered the issue; the hours are counted in elapsed clock time from the request's issue_discovered_at to its submitted_at.

The affected nights are the stay's nights dated on or after the date part of submitted_at and before the check-out date, and the nightly refund is the travel_issue_refund_pct_by_category percentage for the request's issue_category times one night's price times the affected nights.
The guest service fee and occupancy tax are refunded in the proportion that the refunded nightly and cleaning amounts bear to their full amounts.
